name: Banner of Undeath
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura faint necromancy; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

All undead creatures within the radius gain a +2 channel resistance that stacks with any existing channel resistance.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells desecrate
